llm.pacing_note: Run 34002128822 showed four concurrent shards each rejected after ~5 requests with "Please retry in 3.9-38.9s" while the aggregate was only ~4 requests/minute, so the usable free-tier allowance is far below the advertised 20/min. Waits stay bounded and one shared per-process event budget stops the job instead of grinding the quota away.
llm.role: audits drafts, audits negatives, repairs references and grades answers; independent of the candidate

quota_policy: Checkpoint every response and completed case. Pause and ask the user before changing provider/credential profile; never silently replay another model as Qwen.
reference_policy: Original PDF page images and logical DOCX text define draft references; runtime extraction stays unchanged for the agent. Freeze separate answer keys before prediction. Model-authored/audited keys are not expert-certified.
google_scope: Unfinished reference authoring and auditing only; restore candidate_llm for answering unless the user explicitly approves a further switch.
quota_note: Run 34002128822: shards 4/5/7 were each rejected by Google after ~5 requests (RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED, limit: 20, "Please retry in 3.9-38.9s") at ~4 requests/minute in aggregate, while the single shard that had already passed its gate kept working. The reference audit is therefore capped at two workers, with a shared per-process event budget that stops a job from grinding the quota. Authoring itself now uses xKiro Qwen, per user choice, and remains labelled as candidate-model-authored reference drafting.

author_llm.role: drafts the paired family; the same model as the candidate, so authoring alone is not validation

scale_note: First pass is a scaled dataset version: 475 paired scenarios per language (1,425 records) with the same 65/20/10/5 category proportions as the 1,000-per-language target. Authoring still enumerates the identical 900 base specs, so every already-accepted family keeps its cache key; the compiler selects the lowest accepted ID per category. The frozen manifest records scaled_version, how many families were accepted, and which were selected, and the full target stays questions_per_language 1000.

authoring.why: Authoring runs on xKiro Qwen; the reference audit runs on Google, whose free tier measured ~1-2 usable requests/minute. Drafting everything first means a run is never blocked by the scarce provider, and each run still promotes as many audits as the current allowance permits.

audit_independence_note: Accepted families 0-469 were audited by the same model that drafted them (cross_provider_audited 0). Role profiles now separate the providers, so families authored from this revision on are drafted by xKiro Qwen and audited by Google; the snapshot manifest and the frozen dataset manifest carry the counts and the report prints them as a caveat. A same-model audit is not described as independent anywhere.
negative_priority_note: All 469 accepted families are supported ones. The 200 out-of-scope and 50 insufficient-evidence families sit in shards 6-8, which were never reached, so the author matrix is ordered least-progressed-first and the scaled freeze is refused until those categories are filled.
